decisions.reason: After two years on the market, this flagship multi-variant organic salami line is closely aligned with the firm's stated direction and core curing capabilities, so unless results fall clearly below aspiration it should stay.

The organic boiled pork sausage is a low-distance extension of the core range and uses existing know-how, but as a single recent launch it still faces some withdrawal risk if sales do not reach aspiration levels.
This multi-variant organic chicken-breast line fits the firm's move toward broader organic and convenience offerings and therefore is likely to be retained while performance is still being learned.

The organic herb-coated salami is close to the firm's core salami competence, yet as a narrower 2024 flavor variant it is more vulnerable to pruning if it underperforms compared with stronger salami lines.
